title: cleisostoma carinatum
intro: Cleisostoma carinatum, commonly known as the Rough-petaled Cleisostoma or the Rough-petaled Dendrobium, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cleisostoma carinatum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
